{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Drop rows with sentinel values as they represent missing or invalid data
trial_clean = trial_df[~sentinel_mask]

# Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline on the cleaned data
mean_baseline = trial_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_baseline"}
